description: This file defines a mock class 'DisplayMock' for the 'device::DisplayImpl' interface, utilizing Google Mock to facilitate unit testing. The mock class provides virtual methods corresponding to the interface functions, allowing tests to simulate display device behavior.

classes.description: A mock implementation of the device::DisplayImpl interface used for unit testing.
